serverPath.title: Server Path
serverPath.description: Absolute path to a `tinymist` executable. Leave empty to look it up on PATH.

features.title: Features
features.description: Which parts of Tinymist the editor uses. Turning one off hands it to the next server serving the same file.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Report compile errors, and lint findings when linting is on.

autocomplete.title: Autocomplete
autocomplete.description: Offer completions for functions, symbols and paths.

hover.title: Hover
hover.description: Show documentation and rendered values on hover.

signature.title: Signature Help
signature.description: Show the call signature while typing arguments.

definition.title: Go To Definition
definition.description: Jump to where a name is bound.

references.title: Find References
references.description: List the uses of a name.

symbols.title: Symbols
symbols.description: Serve document and project symbols to go-to-symbol.

outline.title: Outline
outline.description: Fill the outline panel with the document's headings.

format.title: Format
format.description: Format documents with the formatter chosen below.

rename.title: Rename
rename.description: Rename a name across the project.

codeActions.title: Code Actions
codeActions.description: Offer Tinymist's fixes in the intentions list.

codeLens.title: Code Lens
codeLens.description: Show the export and preview links above the document.

semanticTokens.title: Semantic Tokens
semanticTokens.description: Colour the document with Tinymist's classification. Turning this off also stops the server computing it.

fontPaths.title: Font Paths
fontPaths.description: Directories, or single font files, to load fonts from in addition to the ones Typst ships. Relative paths resolve against the project root.

systemFonts.title: System Fonts
systemFonts.description: Load the fonts installed on this machine. Turning this off makes a document compile the same way everywhere, at the cost of the fonts you have locally.

rootPath.title: Root Path
rootPath.description: The directory Typst treats as the root, which absolute paths in a document resolve against. Leave empty to use the project folder.

outputPath.title: Output Path
outputPath.description: Where exports are written. `$root` and `$dir` are the project root and the document's directory, and `$name` is its name without the extension. Leave empty to write beside the document.

exportPdf.title: Export PDF
exportPdf.description: When to export a PDF. Off by default because the `typst-tools` package already compiles Typst documents, and both on means every save exports twice.

exportTarget.title: Export Target
exportTarget.description: What the document is compiled to. `paged` is the usual page-based output; `html` targets Typst's HTML export.

typstExtraArgs.title: Typst Arguments
typstExtraArgs.description: Extra arguments passed to the compiler, as they would be written on a `typst compile` command line.

projectResolution.title: Project Resolution
projectResolution.description: How the file being edited is matched to the document it belongs to. `singleFile` compiles each file on its own; `lockDatabase` reads the project lock file, so editing an included file compiles the document that includes it.

syntaxOnly.title: Syntax Only
syntaxOnly.description: Answer from the syntax tree alone, without compiling. Much cheaper, but there are no rendered values, no cross-file navigation and no compile errors. `auto` decides per document.

formatterMode.title: Formatter
formatterMode.description: Which formatter formats Typst documents. Both are built into Tinymist and need nothing installed.

formatterPrintWidth.title: Formatter Print Width
formatterPrintWidth.description: Column the formatter tries to stay within. Set to 0 to use the formatter's own default.

formatterProseWrap.title: Formatter Prose Wrap
formatterProseWrap.description: Let the formatter break prose at the print width, rather than leaving paragraphs as written.

lint.title: Lint
lint.description: Tinymist can report style and correctness warnings on top of the compiler's own errors.

when.title: When
when.description: How often the document is linted.

postfix.title: Postfix Completions
postfix.description: Offer completions that wrap what you have already written, such as turning a value into a call.

symbol.title: Symbol Completions
symbol.description: How a symbol such as `sym.alpha` is completed. `step` completes one part at a time; `stepless` offers the whole name at once.

triggerOnSnippetPlaceholders.title: Trigger On Snippet Placeholders
triggerOnSnippetPlaceholders.description: Offer completions inside the placeholders of an accepted snippet.
